hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts) [ -x node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f"; [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] && node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.env|*.pem|*.key|*secrets*) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Blocked: looks like a secret/env file: " + $f)}}' ;; esac
